issue.title: Triage presentation_fingerprint omits created_by, closed_at, and full task_type_fields that the TaskTriage gate renders

task_type_fields.impact:
Triage gates can show the owner stale typed-field content or provenance. Low severity,
but adding the inputs changes every stored fingerprint. Since sase-1tz.4.1.8 a
re-presentation adopts the existing notification row in place (no new rows), so the fix
can pair the new inputs with a one-time adopt-in-place refresh or a fingerprint-scheme
version bump without a notification storm.
task_type_fields.repro:
Proposed by phase sase-1tz.4.1.8 (triage_volume) note #6; filed by the sase-1tz.4.1 land agent.

Root cause: `presentation_fingerprint` (`src/sase/scripts/_bead_task_triage_gates.py`)
hashes title, description, notes, created_at, size, refs, +1 evidence, close history,
snooze, status, and an optional `task_type_display` facts block. But the TaskTriage
preview also renders `created_by` ("Filed by"), the bead's top-level `closed_at` (the
post-close +1 markers), and the full `task_type_fields` body. None of those are hashed
(confirmed on master 39b594a30c), so editing them leaves a pending gate showing stale
content.

Repro: create a ready typed task bead so a TaskTriage gate is pending; change one of its
`task_type_fields` values (or `created_by`/`closed_at`) without touching the hashed
fields; run the bead_task_triage chop; the pending gate is not re-presented and its
preview still shows the old value.

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1tz.4.1.8 found fingerprint under-coverage that leaves pending triage gates stale; the sase-1tz.4.1 land agent is filing its proposed follow-up.
